description: This file defines the 'Glossary' class within the Goteo project's codebase. It manages glossary entries, including retrieving, listing, validating, and saving glossary data, as well as handling associated media and images.

classes.name: Glossary
classes.description: A class representing a glossary entry with functionalities for retrieval, listing, validation, and persistence of glossary data along with associated media and images.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of language-specific fields for the Glossary entries.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a single glossary entry by ID, with optional language parameter, including associated media and images.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all glossary entries ordered alphabetically, including associated media and images.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the glossary object ensuring required fields are present.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the glossary object to the database, including handling associated image uploads.
